samples.where: email to his brother and sisters
samples.title: Caravan 2026 costs and weeks
samples.body:
Dear Jan, Pete and Carol,

The park bill for 2026 has come in at £4,736 all in so that is £1,184 each between the four of us. Please can you pay me by the end of January into the usual account, same as last year.

The weeks are as follows as we agreed at Mums in October. Jan last week of July. Pete and Linda May half term. Carol Easter and the second week of September. Me and Bev the first week of June and whatever is left over.

I have had the gas checked and the water heater looked at, it is fine now. Please can everyone make sure the water is turned off at the stop tap when you leave as the park has warned us twice about it.

Any problems let me know.

Regards
Mick

samples.title: Quote for bathroom
samples.body:
Dear Mrs Pickering,

Thank you for having us round on Monday. As discussed the quote for the bathroom is below.

Remove old suite and dispose. Supply and fit new close coupled toilet, basin and pedestal, and shower over bath with screen. New isolating valves throughout. Make good where needed but not tiling, you said your son in law is doing that.

Total £2,450 inc materials. We can start the week of the 23rd if that suits, job should be four days.

We ask for 30 percent up front for materials and the rest on completion.

Any questions please ring me on the mobile.

Kind regards
Mick Thornton
Thornton Plumbing & Heating

samples.title: Re: Mum's boiler
samples.body:
Carol,

I went round Mum's on Saturday and had a look. It is the pressure dropping again, there is a small leak on the valve under the sink in the kitchen which I have fixed. I have topped it up and showed her how to do it but you know what she is like, she won't touch it.

The boiler is 14 year old now and I think we need to look at changing it before winter. I can do it at cost, it will be about £1,900 for the boiler and parts. I think it should be split between us four like the caravan but I wanted to ask you first before I put it to the others.

Let me know what you think.

Mick

samples.title: Plot C14 - drain
samples.body:
Hello,

We have a problem with the drain on our plot C14, the waste pipe from the caravan is backing up and it is not the caravan side as I have checked it myself, I am a plumber. Please can someone from the park look at the main run before my sister goes up on the 7th.

Thanks
Mick Thornton
